summary: The page generally respects the dark theme and RTL layout, but exhibits RTL mirroring failures in progress bar fills and AvatarGroup stacking collisions.

issues.title: Progress fill direction unmirrored in RTL
issues.description: Progress tracks fill from left to right instead of right to left under RTL direction.
issues.evidence: The 18% progress card shows active fill anchored to the left instead of the right.
issues.suggestion: Reverse progress fill origin to anchor from the right in RTL mode.

issues.title: AvatarGroup overlap and counter collision in RTL
issues.description: AvatarGroup stack order and negative margins do not adapt to RTL, causing visual collision.
issues.evidence: Top-left avatar group shows the '6+' counter badge overlapping directly on top of the 'RM' avatar.
issues.suggestion: Use RTL-aware margin utilities and reversed stacking order for AvatarGroup.
